rationale: SNY has already gapped up 7.6% on what appears to be a news-driven catalyst, and price is now consolidating tightly near the upper 75% of today's range with extremely compressed 1-minute candles (range ~$0.04) and declining volume on recent bars. The ATR of $0.14 on 5-minute bars makes it difficult to place a meaningful stop without excessive risk relative to potential reward, and with the broader market under pressure (SPY -1.04%, VIXY +5.27%), chasing a large gap-up in a risk-off environment offers an unfavorable asymmetry in either direction.
